layer_3_action.subject: Sun-drenched seasonal semi-arid floodplain
features: A landscape of drying mudflats and sandy rises
Vibrant green carpets of moss and ferns appearing in low-lying tracks
Stunted Ginkgos and leathery Cycads providing sparse shade
Deeply textured mud-cracks illuminated by the high sun
No grass; only primitive, fast-growing ground cover
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic landscape at noon showing a wide plain in transition. The lighting is warm and golden, highlighting the textures of the parched earth and the pockets of prehistoric greenery.

visuals.ground: Vividly cracked mud and sandy silt. The green life is comprised of low-lying, ancient spore-bearing plants that grow quickly after rain. Absolutely no grass.
visuals.sky: Brilliant blue sky, wide and open, with no clouds.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Hard-baked mud plates and wind-blown silt.
